source: Workload review, 25 Nov. Written by an agent, not measured.

watch.title: A 13-hour day, then a late drive
watch.detail: Shift until 20:15, then Reading to Somerset from 20:30 to 23:30. Last night's 10 h sleep is a better base than the earlier late drives. Straight there, no extra stops, and not if already tired.

watch.title: Not a rest day
watch.detail: Lunch, then the drive back from 16:00 to 19:00 makes 5.5 h of commitments. Keep the evening after 19:00 clear.

watch.title: The sharpest day ahead
watch.detail: A 06:00 leave for a 07:00 shift, the Southampton car swap from 16:50, then Union until 02:00 as a VP duty, the night before Cornwall. Hand the late part to another committee member and push the Cornwall drive to after a proper sleep.

watch.title: Drive home after checkout
watch.detail: Checkout is 09:30 and the return drive is not in the calendar. Monday has lectures, Town Night and an all-day engineer visit in Somerset, which cannot all happen.

watch.title: Late car swap after swim
watch.detail: Practical, lecture, swim, then Southampton and back by 22:45. Straight to sleep afterwards.

habits: Hard stop for coding at 23:00. Late commits are often an agent already.
After any night under 6 h, keep the next morning clear and be in bed by about 23:30.
Aim for 7 h or more before a flying day or a long drive.
Rotate the late part of VP duty so one person is not closing every social.
